rows.name: Port on Craig
rows.description: West, a white tower, 76 ft. high; East, a pile lighthouse, 1,700 yds. apart. In one, W.N.W., lead up the Tay Br. lts. on Tayport piers and at Broughty Ferry

rows.name: Newport
rows.description: On the West Ferry pier. In one, N.N.E., 63 yards apart

rows.name: Dundee Harbour
rows.character: 1. Two fixed red lts. 2. Red and bright lts. 3. Two fixed red lts. 4. Fixed lights
rows.description: 1. On middle and E. piers. In one, N.W. by W., lead S.W. of Beacon Rock 2. On Ferry pier at Dundee, to lead East of Middle Bank 3. Tide lts. at entrance of Camperdown Dock 4. Channel for passing the Tay Railway Bridge is shown by seven lights, the two outermost red, centre lts. bright. Vessels should steer to pass directly under either of the br. lts.

rows.name: Arbroath
rows.description: Light on East pier, red when 10 ft. water in harbour, and bright when less. Bright light on West pier. Red light at Signal-tower. Green light on West side of harbour. All changed to green in bad weather, when unsafe to enter

rows.name: MONTROSE NESS
rows.description: Scurdy Ness. A white brick tower, 127 feet high, on S. point of entrance. Light alternately bright 30 secs., and eclipsed 30 secs.

rows.name: Montrose Harbour
rows.description: White towers, 65 and 39 ft. high, on the North side of entrance, 960 feet apart. In one, N.W. by W. ¾ W., lead into the river

rows.name: Johnshaven
rows.description: Two fixed bright lights, when boats at sea

rows.name: Gourdon
rows.description: Two fixed bright lights, when boats at sea

rows.name: Stonehaven
rows.description: East, or low light, bright, upper red. On inner side of harbour. In one, W. by N. ½ N.

rows.name: GIRDLENESS
rows.description: In one tower, 120 ft. high

rows.name: Aberdeen
rows.character: 1. One fixed br. Tide lt. 2. Two fix. red or gr. lts. 3. Red, br., & green lts.
rows.description: 1. & 2. Tide light, bright, on North pier-head, from ½-flood to high water. When entrance is safe, the two lights at Torry are red; when ships cannot enter, green. In one, W. by S., they lead in 3. At head of S. breakwater, 4 ft. apart, vertically. Not shown in bad weather, when N. pier light is obscured over S. breakwater head

rows.name: Port Erroll
rows.description: Fix. br. lt. on pier; 2 red lts. in fishing season

rows.name: BUCHANNESS
rows.description: Stone tower, 115 ft. high. Light shown from N. by E. to S.W. ¾ W., by East and South

rows.name: Boddom
rows.character: 1. Two fixed red lights 2. Two fixed red lights
rows.description: 1. In one, lead through South entrance. Only in fishing season 2. In one, lead through North entrance

rows.name: Peterhead
rows.description: Bright light on elbow of W. pier in S. harbour. Red light on W. pier in N. harbour; shown to East, betw. E. ¾ N. and N.E. ½ N. Green lt. on N. breakwater when entr. dangerous

rows.name: Fraserburgh
rows.character: 1. Two fixed red lights 2. One fixed green light
rows.description: 1. On N. pier-head and middle pier. In one, S.E. by E., 228 ft. apart, lead into S. harbour 2. At seaward end of breakwater; shown seaward, between S. ½ W. and N. by E. (When harbours are closed for improvements, the lights are discontinued, and a fixed green light is shown on end of North pier, South of entrance to Balaclava Harbour)

rows.name: KINNAIRD HEAD
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: White stone tower, 76 ft. high. Light red over Rattray Brigs, westward of S.E. by S.

rows.name: Sandhaven
rows.description: Two fixed bright lights

rows.name: Rosehearty
rows.description: Bright light on outer extremity of T head pier, and red light. Leading lights

rows.name: Gardenstown
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: On East pier-head; bright East of S.E., and red to westward

rows.name: Macduff
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: On the North pier-head. Bright over Cottie Rocks, red to the westward

rows.name: Banff
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright lt. 2. Two fixed lights
rows.description: 1. On North pier-head 2. High bright lt., with lower red lt., in upper part of new harbour; visible when entrance is open. In one, S.E. ¾ S., lead in
